title: Pip and Hazel's I Spy Hello
learning: first letters of words (A is for apple)
moral: A gentle hello and a game to share can turn someone new into a friend.
description: Someone new has moved into Clover Wood: Hazel, a teeny, shy hedgehog! Pip zooms over to say hello with a BONK, and Tumble's hello comes out as a HONK. Play I Spy and learn first letters like A for apple and S for snail in this funny animated story about making a new friend, for kids aged 3 to 8.

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo-hoo! New friends can feel shy, my dears. Go slowly, speak softly, and invite them to play a game.
Nana's round glasses slid down, down, DOWN her beak.

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Try I Spy! You say, I spy something beginning with... and a letter. Like... I spy something beginning with Z... zzzzz...
Hee hee! Nana fell fast asleep, right in the middle of her sentence!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: I'm awake! I'm awake! Z is for... zebra!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Hello, Hazel. Would you like to play the eye-spy-eye-ball game? I mean... I Spy!

narration.speaker: hazel
narration.text: Ooh, I love I Spy! I spy with my little eye... something beginning with A!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Ooh! Ooh! I know! A is for... BANANA!

narration.text: Now Hazel wasn't shy anymore! She giggled and played, and her prickles went all wiggly-jiggly.

narration.speaker: hazel
narration.text: I spy something beginning with T. It's big and grey, and it's very, very kind!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Is it... a tree? A teapot? A TOOTHBRUSH?
Hee hee! It's Tumble! T is for Tumble! And Tumble honked the happiest HONK ever!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: And I spy F! F is for FRIENDS! Super-duper!

narration.text: Super-duper YES! And next time, I'll say hello sloooowly.
Pip whispered the gentlest hello ever... then tripped over a pinecone. Boing!
Everybody giggled. Because a gentle hello and a game to share can turn someone new into a friend.
